headline: Approved $5,605.75 change order for Springdale paving and sale of surplus compressor to Malden for $1.
summary: Approved October rent and revolving fund payment registers, along with YMCA and police invoices. Also adopted Section 8 payment standards effective January 1, 2027, and approved a $250 donation to Junior Aid Association of Malden.
decisions: Approved the October 2026 Section 8 and MVRP rent payment register totaling $1,594,743.27, unanimously.
Approved the October 2026 Revolving Fund Register totaling $3,118,448.41, unanimously.
Approved payment of $8,333.34 to the Malden YMCA for resident memberships, paid by the COCC, unanimously.
Approved payment of nine Malden Police Department invoices totaling $4,892.16, paid by the AMPs served, unanimously.
Approved sale of an unused surplus compressor to the City of Malden Department of Public Works for $1.00, 3-0.
Adopted Section 8 FY2027 program payment standards by bedroom size, effective 01/01/2027, unanimously.
Approved change order from Site Improvements Inc. for $5,605.75 on the Springdale Paving Project, paid by the State through CapHub, 3-0.
Approved seven Section 8 staff members to attend the December 9, 2026 Section 8 seminar, at a cost of $525.00 paid by the COCC, unanimously.
Approved a $250.00 donation to Junior Aid Association of Malden for its Holiday Soiree, paid by the COCC, unanimously.

transcript:
11/10/26

# THE REGULAR MEETING OF THE MALDEN HOUSING AUTHORITY

The regular meeting of the Malden Housing Authority (MHA) was held on November 10, 2026, at 8:30 AM at the office of MHA, 630 Salem Street, Malden, MA 02148. All votes are by roll call with a remote Commissioner.

- **COMMISSIONERS ATTENDING:** Joan M. Chiasson, William P. Hurley and Karin H. Nystrom
- **COMMISSIONERS ATTENDING REMOTELY:** Emmanuel Marsh
- **COMMISSIONERS ABSENT:** Frank M. Molis
- **MHA STAFF:** Stephen G. Finn and Barbara A. Hooley
- **MHA STAFF ATTENDING REMOTELY:** Thomas P. Callaghan

## 1. APPROVAL OF MINUTES 10-27-26

The Board was presented with the 10-27-26 minutes.

After due discussion and upon motion duly made by Karin H. Nystrom and seconded by William P. Hurley, it was unanimously:

**VOTED:** To approve the 10-27-26 Minutes.

- **Ayes:** Joan M. Chiasson, Emmanuel Marsh, William P. Hurley and Karin H. Nystrom
- **Nays:** None

## 2. APPROVAL OF THE BILLS AND SIGNING OF CHECKS

The Board perused the Section 8 and MRVP Rent Payment Register for October, 2026 totaling $1,594,743.27.

After due discussion and upon motion duly made by William P. Hurley and seconded by Karin H. Nystrom, it was unanimously:

**VOTED:** To approve the bills and signing of checks for Section 8 and MVRP Rent Payment Register for October, 2026.

- **Ayes:** Joan M. Chiasson, Emmanuel Marsh, William P. Hurley and Karin H. Nystrom
- **Nays:** None

The Board reviewed td the Revolving Fund Register for October, 2026 totaling $3,118,448.41.

After due discussion and upon motion duly made by William P. Hurley and seconded by Karin H. Nystrom, it was unanimously:

**VOTED:** To approve the Revolving Fund Register for October, 2026.

- **Ayes:** Joan M. Chiasson, Emmanuel Marsh, William P. Hurley and Karin H. Nystrom
- **Nays:** None

## 3. FINANCIAL MATTERS

### A. EOHLC FY2026 CERTIFICATIONS-- (Review Only)

The Executive Director transmitted to the Board for its review the EOHLC required FY2026 Board Certification Resolutions: Compliance with notification procedures for Federal and State lead paint laws; Top five (5) Compensation form: Year-End Financial Statement and Tenants Accounts Receivable Data; Fiscal Year End Certification of Preparer and Executive Director, Wagematch User Certification and CHAMP PMR Fair Housing Reporting. A vote on the certifications is anticipated at the next meeting.

### B. MALDEN YMCA--Invoices (2)

The Board reviewed two (2) dated invoices from several months ago from the YMCA as follows:

| Program | Date | Amount | Amt Charged |
|---|---|---|---|
| Resident Memberships-July 2026 | 8-3-26 | $4,166.67 | COCC |
| Resident Memberships-August 2026 | 9-1-26 | $4,166.67 | COCC |
| **Total** | | **$8,333.34** | **COCC** |

After due discussion and upon motion duly made by William P. Hurley and seconded by Karin H. Nystrom, it was unanimously:

**VOTED:** To approve payment in the amount of $8,333.34 to the YMCA as detailed above with cost paid by the COCC.

- **Ayes:** Joan M. Chiasson, Emmanuel Marsh, William P. Hurley and Karin H. Nystrom
- **Nays:** None

### C. MALDEN POLICE DEPARTMENT--Invoices (9)

The Board studied nine (9) invoices from the Malden Police as follows

| Invoice # | Date | Amount |
|---|---|---|
| 37769 | 10-23-26 | $337.39 |
| 37783 | 10-26-26 | $674.78 |
| 37802 | 10-27-26 | $1,012.17 |
| 37823 | 10-29-26 | $337.39 |
| 37847 | 11-2-26 | $1,686.95 |
| 37864 | 11-4-26 | **$506.09 |
| 37874 | 11-5-26 | $337.39 |
| **TOTAL** | | **$4,892.16** |

**\*\*Detail was scheduled on a Holiday (Election Day) at time and a half wage. MPD did not follow policy of no details on Holidays.**

After due discussion and upon motion duly made by Karin H. Nystrom and seconded by William P. Hurley, it was unanimously:

**VOTED:** To approve payment of nine (9) invoices from the Malden Police Department totaling $4,892.16 as detailed above with cost to be paid by the AMP's served.

- **Ayes:** William P. Hurley, Joan M. Chiasson, Emmanuel Marsh and Karin H. Nystrom
- **Nays:** None

**Emmanuel Marsh left the meeting**

### D. MHA'S DISPOSITION OF PROPERTY--Compressor

The Board considered MHA's disposition of an unused surplus compressor for nominal consideration to the City of Malden Department of Public Works and authorization and approval for Executive to execute the Bill of Sale in the amount of $1.00.

After due discussion and upon motion duly made by William P. Hurley and seconded by Karin H. Nystrom, it was unanimously:

**VOTED:** To approve disposition of MHA's unused surplus compressor to the City of Malden as detailed above and authorize the Executive Director to execute the Bill of Sale in the amount of $1.00.

- **Ayes:** William P. Hurley, Joan M. Chiasson and Karin H. Nystrom
- **Nays:** None

### E. SECTION 8 PROGRAM PAYMENT STANDARDS--Effective 01/01/2027

The Board assessed the Section 8 FY2027 Program Payment Standards by bedroom size for the four (4) FMR jurisdictions in which the MHA administers voucher assistance to be implemented as of 01/01/2027.

After due discussion and upon motion duly made by Karin H. Nystrom and seconded by William P. Hurley, it was unanimously:

**VOTED:** To adopt as presented the Section 8 FY2027 Program Payment Standards by bedroom size for the four (4) FMR jurisdictions in which the MHA administers voucher assistance to be implemented as of 01/01/2027.

- **Ayes:** William P. Hurley, Joan M. Chiasson and Karin H. Nystrom
- **Nays:** None

### F. SITE IMPROVEMENTS INC.--Change Order

The Board analyzed a change order dated 11-6-26 in the amount of $5,605.75 from Site Improvements Inc. for additional work on the Springdale Paving Project with cost to be paid by the State through CapHub.

After due discussion and upon motion duly made by William P. Hurley and seconded by Karen H. Nystrom, it was unanimously:

**VOTED:** To approve change order from Site Improvements Inc. in the amount of $5,605.75 as detailed above with cost paid by the State through CapHub.

- **Ayes:** William P. Hurley, Joan M. Chiasson and Karin H. Nystrom
- **Nays:** None

**Emmanuel Marsh rejoined the meeting**

### G. SECTION 8 ADMINISTRATORS ASSOCIATION--Annual Meeting

The Board reviewed a request for approval for MHA Section 8 Staff Members (7) to attend "The Section 8 Administrators Need to Know Seminar" on December 9, 2026 at Maggiano's Little Italy, Boston, MA with total cost of $525.00 to be paid by the COCC.

After due discussion and upon motion duly made by William P. Hurley and seconded by Karen H. Nystrom, it was unanimously:

**VOTED:** To approve MHA Section 8 Staff to attend Section 8 Seminar as detailed above with cost to be paid by the COCC.

- **Ayes:** William P. Hurley, Joan M. Chiasson, Emmanuel Marsh and Karin H. Nystrom
- **Nays:** None

## 4. POLICIES AND CONTRACTS

a) MHA Administration Plan Draft effective 01/01/2027 (Review only)

## 5. REVIEW OF CHARITABLE REQUESTS

a) The Board perused a request from Junior Aid Association of Malden for a donation to sponsor their Holiday Soiree Event on 12/19/2026.

After due discussion and upon motion duly made by William P. Hurley and seconded by Karin H. Nystrom, it was unanimously:

**VOTED:** To approve donation in the amount of $250.00 to Junior Aid Association of Malden with cost paid by the COCC.

- **Ayes:** William P. Hurley, Joan M. Chiasson, Emmanuel Marsh and Karin H. Nystrom
- **Nays:** None

## 6. CORRESPONDENCE, PUBLICATIONS AND COMMUNICATIONS:

a) PHADA Advocate: November 11, 2026

## 7. REVIEW OF APPROVED FOR PAYMENT CAPITAL INVOICES, REQUISITIONS FOR PAYMENT AND ALL OTHER APPLICABLE PROJECT DOCEMENTATION (EDIFICATION ONLY)

a) Invoice dated 11/3/26 in the amount of $8,250.00 from MK Architecture for Design Work on the Amp 1-Phase 2 Linden Window and Siding Project with cost paid by the CFP.

b) Application and Certificate for Payment dated 10-28-26 in the amount of $174,098.93 from Southcoast Improvement Company for the AMP 2 Suffolk Manor Gas to Electrification Project with cost paid by the CFP.

## 8. REVIEW OF APPROVED TRAINING AND CONFERNCE OFFERINGS

a) "Save the Date" Annual Legislative Advocacy Day at the Massachusetts State House-March 31, 2027.

## 9. OPEN DISCUSSION

a) MHA Staff Thank You Notes for the Performance Bonus for the Linden Window and Siding Project.

b) Greater Malden Behavioral Health 11th Annual Thanksgiving Breakfast Tuesday, November 24th 9:30 am in the 630 Salem Street Community Room.

c) MHA Low Loss Achievement Award from the Housing Authority Insurance Group.

d) HUD Congratulatory Letter: FY2025 Section 8 SEMAP High Performer Status.

e) HUD PHA Accountability Dashboard Report for MHA - 7/31/2026.

f) "Reminder" MHA's Holiday Party: Thursday, December 17th Noon Anthony's of Malden.

## ADJOURNMENT

After due discussion and upon motion duly made by Karin H. Nystrom and seconded by William P. Hurley, it was unanimously:

**VOTED:** To Adjourn

- **Ayes:** William P. Hurley, Joan M. Chiasson, Emmanuel Marsh and Karin H. Nystrom
- **Nays:** None

Adjourned at 9:05 AM

[signature] Emmanuel Marsh, Secretary
